verdict.rationale: Bland's official MCP server lets coding agents manage agents, build pathways and place calls. Its official CLI covers making calls, building pathways and configuring phone numbers from the terminal. Together these cover creating the agent, attaching a number and placing a call without the dashboard. missing for 10: a documented end-to-end provisioning walkthrough tying the steps together, explicit evidence of buying or attaching a number to an agent via API/MCP (only the CLI's one-line 'configure phone numbers'), a reachable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: The Bland MCP server lets any AI agent work with your Bland account through natural language: place and inspect calls, send texts, build and validate pathways, manage agents
Manage your entire Bland account from the terminal: make calls, build and test pathways, configure phone numbers, and more.
the bot starts the flow over a plain API call
See the Pathways API reference to create and manage pathways programmatically.
